habitat.name: Emerald Duck Pond
habitat.climate: Temperate and humid with warm summers and cool winters
habitat.description: A calm freshwater pond featuring a muddy bank, lush aquatic vegetation, open water zones, and a shallow sunlit bottom.

organisms.imagePrompt: vibrant green microscopic filaments forming mats on the water surface
organisms.description: Tiny photosynthetic organisms that form floating green mats and produce food from sunlight.

organisms.imagePrompt: tall green reed plants with brown cigar-shaped seed heads near the shore
organisms.description: Tall emergent wetland plants that provide vertical shelter and food along the shoreline.
adaptations: Air channels in stems to survive underwater

organisms.imagePrompt: small aquatic larval frog with a long tail grazing on algae
organisms.description: Herbivorous larval amphibians that scrape algae from submerged rocks and stems.

organisms.imagePrompt: small spiral shelled snail clinging to a plant stem
organisms.description: Slow-moving shelled gastropods that graze on decaying plant matter and microscopic algae.

organisms.imagePrompt: colorful drake duck dabbling in the shallow water
organisms.description: Dabbling ducks that consume aquatic plants, seeds, snails, and small insects.
adaptations: Flat bill for straining food from water

organisms.imagePrompt: green spotted frog sitting on a lily pad
organisms.description: Carnivorous amphibians that ambush insects, worms, and small tadpoles near the water edge.

organisms.imagePrompt: tall grey wading bird standing still in shallow water
organisms.description: Large wading apex predators that spear fish, frogs, and large aquatic creatures.
adaptations: Long wading legs for deep water

organisms.imagePrompt: microscopic view of detritivore microbes breaking down organic sludge
organisms.description: Microscopic organisms that break down dead leaves and animal waste, recycling nutrients into the soil and water.

relationships.description: Tadpoles consume green algae for energy.
Pond snails use cattail stems as surfaces for crawling and egg deposition without harming the plant.
Frogs consume tadpoles and small aquatic animals.
Mallard ducks eat pond snails along with other aquatic snacks.
Great blue herons hunt and consume frogs.

environmentalFeatures.name: Benthic Mud
environmentalFeatures.description: Nutrient-rich sediment at the bottom of the pond where decomposers thrive.

environmentalFeatures.name: Sunken Log
environmentalFeatures.description: A decaying wooden log providing shelter and perching spots.

challenges.prompt: Which microscopic organism forms floating green mats and uses sunlight to produce food?
challenges.explanation: Green Algae are producers that capture sunlight to create their own food.

challenges.prompt: Which tall emergent wetland plant provides vertical shelter and has brown cigar-shaped seed heads?
challenges.explanation: Cattails grow along the shore and offer structural support and shelter.

challenges.prompt: Which herbivorous larval amphibian swims with a long tail and grazes on algae?
challenges.explanation: Tadpoles scrape algae from underwater surfaces using specialized mouthparts.

challenges.prompt: Which slow-moving shelled gastropod crawls on plant stems and grazes on detritus?
challenges.explanation: Pond Snails graze on decaying matter and algae while using plant stems for support.

challenges.prompt: Which large wading apex predator stands still in shallow water to spear fish and frogs?
challenges.explanation: The Great Blue Heron is an apex predator relying on sharp vision and a dagger-like bill.

disruptionScenario.event: A sudden dry spell lowers the water level and reduces the surface area of floating green algae.
cascadeEffects: Tadpoles have less algae to graze upon, causing their population to decline.
Frogs face reduced food availability, leading to fewer predators for higher trophic levels.
disruptionScenario.question: How does a drop in the producer population ripple through the pond food chain?
